name: 02466 · Auburndale, MA
findings: ZIP 02466 (Auburndale) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02466 (Auburndale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02466 (Auburndale) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
